programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform works by Gabriel Fauré, Franz Schubert, Sergei Rachmaninoff, Hugo Wolf, Rodion Shchedrin, and Bart Visman, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform ‘Mandoline’ and ‘À Clymène’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Cinq melodies de Venise, Op. 58; ‘Lied der Delphine’ from Franz Schubert’s Zwei Szenen aus dem Schauspiel ‘Lacrimas’, D. 857; ‘Son’ (A dream) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; ‘Elfenlied’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Staccato’ from Rodion Shchedrin’s Three solfege exercises; and Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: In this 30-minute film, children have their say; boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recount Mozart's life in their own words. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children. The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 Heroic, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Suite No. 1, Op. 5 - IV. Easter
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Slatkin conducts Bolcom, Beethoven & Ravel
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Antonio Chen Guang
programme.desc: Pianist Antonio Chen Guang (China, 1994) joins the CMIM ensemble in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). Pianist Antonio Chen Guang (China, 1994) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at Bourgie Hall in the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Kirill Karabits conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. Soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Recorded on December 8th, 2021. Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale - a child’s vision of Heaven - lies a world of profound emotion and beauty. With soprano Lucy Crowe lending her vocal radiance to this extraordinary finale, the symphony’s journey to bliss is complete. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on December 8, 2021.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. On the program are works by Christoph Willibald Gluck, J.S. Bach and W.A. Mozart. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024. Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S. Bach’s brilliant cantata aria ‘Jauchzet Gott in allen Landen!’, BWV 51, featuring soprano Marlin González Zúñiga and trumpeter Marc Ferrando Pelegrí, and W.A. Mozart’s joyous motet Exsultate, jubilate, K. 165, sung by soprano Carla Isabel Gómez del Pulgar. The concert concludes with one of the great classical works: Mozart’s dramatic Symphony No. 40 in G minor. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features the Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece. The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press. The conductor's lucidity, efficiency, and lack of pretension, promoted a relaxed collaboration between himself and the orchestra, which is particularly evident in the rehearsal process. This ‘In Rehearsal’ episode features Salonen rehearsing Claude Debussy's Impressionistic orchestral piece La Mer with the Los Angeles Philharmonic at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion of the Music Center of Los Angeles County. It gives a fascinating insight into Salonen’s rapport with his musicians and also into Debussy’s masterpiece.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. This performance was recorded at St. Mary’s Church in Wittenberg, Germany. Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No. 3 in C major for violin solo, BWV 1005; arias ‘Hier, in meines Vaters Stätte’, BWV 32 and ‘Die Welt mit allen Königreichen’, BWV 59; Suite No. 5 in C minor for cello solo, BWV 1011; ‘Wenn Trost und Hülf ermangeln muß’, BWV 117; ‘Ja, ja, ich halte Jesum fest’, BWV 157; Invention No. 7 in E minor, BWV 778; Invention in A major, BWV 783; and ‘Welt ade, ich bin dein müde’, BWV 158. This performance was recorded at St. Mary’s Church in Wittenberg, Germany.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 & Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler’s Fifth Symphony. Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt’s First Piano Concerto. Recorded on May 15th, 2022. American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondráček as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006. programme.title: Closed - A Ballet from Real Life
programme.desc: In the film Closed we encounter four completely different people who once a week leave their everyday lives and get together in a closed café, where they get the opportunity and help to relax and momentarily distance themselves from reality. Many people live in a closed world. What happens to them when they step onto an arena where they can be themselves, free of their usual roles and status? In the film Closed we encounter four completely different people who once a week leave their everyday lives and get together in a closed café, where they get the opportunity and help to relax and momentarily distance themselves from reality. These encounters have a certain touch of ritual to them. Here, the participants dare to open themselves up to external impressions. They allow themselves to be affected by each other’s liberated exposures and to respond positively to what society at large would regard as strange behaviour. Two men, one woman and a proprietor who is obsessed with cleaning. The smallest speck of dust must be removed immediately. He always has a dust cloth to hand. This externalized and bizarre behaviour is challenging to himself as well as to those around him. Music: Zoltan Kodály’s Sonata for solo cello Op. 8 by cellist Truls Mørk.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: Recorded in the Philharmonie Berlin on occasion of the 40th anniversary of the ensemble; soloists: Annette Dasch (soprano), Till Brönner (trumpet). Since 1972 the 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker have been a prominent institution in international musical life. Listeners around the world are invariably fascinated by the wide range of the unique and intoxicating timbres that these twelve cellos can produce, whether they are playing classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde. Their mixture of seriousness and humour, of depth and lightness, appeals to audiences of all ages. Recorded in the Philharmonie Berlin on occasion of the 40th anniversary of the ensemble; soloists: Annette Dasch (soprano), Till Brönner (trumpet).

programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, pianists Martha Argerich and Khramouchin’s widow Eliane Reyes perform Maurice Ravel’s Ma mère l'Oye. This five-part suite was written for piano four hands.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most loved pieces of the composer, the music of which has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairytale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art. For almost thirty years, he has been the art director of the Houston Ballet, and under his leadership the company has grown into an internationally acknowledged ballet theatre. Since the year 2003 he’s held the position of Artistic Director of the Texas Ballet. His stage productions have earned several awards and praise from the critics, and have been staged at Opéra de Paris, Canadian National Ballet, La Scala, Bavarian State Opera, London City Ballet etc. This performance of the Nutcracker is recorded at the Teatro La Fenice (Venice) in 2012. With the Estonian National Ballet and star dancers Vladislav Lantratov and Galina Laush.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2013. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff, who adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2, offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Completed in the autumn of 1806, the symphony’s first performance was at a private concert in Vienna in March of 1807. Symphony No. 4 is often overshadowed by its revolutionary predecessor and successor. With its lightweight and cheerful nature, Symphony No. 4 contrasts with the two aforementioned works. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2013.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021. The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Johannes Brahms’s Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata, serija
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains. Several men are courting the rich courtesan Violetta, but when she meets Alfredo, she chooses to live a new life with him. She then moves from Paris to the French countryside, but unfortunately is haunted by her past: Alfredo's father does not approve of his past and convinces her to abandon his son. Alfredo is ignorant of his father's torment and, thinking that Violetta has used him, he becomes furious. In the end, he understands that Violetta has abandoned him to be free, but it is too late. Reaching an incurable illness, Violetta dies in his arms.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. Zajedno dožive brojne komične zgode, u koje Maša upadne zbog svoje razigranosti i znatiželje.

U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. Zajedno dožive brojne komične zgode, u koje Maša upadne zbog svoje razigranosti i znatiželje.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u CoComelon svijet! CoComelon je glazbena animirana serija koja prati malog JJ-a i njegovu obitelj u svakodnevim situacijama s kojima se mogu poistovjetiti svi predškolci. Svaki dan uče nešto novo - slova, brojeve, boje, životinje i još mnogo toga. A sve to kroz igru i pjesmice koje lako ulaze u uho!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Elita, reality show

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Aktuelno, premijerno, za korak ispred svih - Premijera je zbog toga najgledanija kratka forma vesti o poznatima. Ne postoji javna ličnost do koje premijerna ekipa ne može doći, a nijedan gradski događaj ne može proći bez njih. I u novoj sezoni najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde govoriće pred Premijerinim kamerama, ali kroz nove rubrike: Ličnost dana, VIP online, Sa beogradskih ulica i Ispred premijernog objektiva.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Sudbina, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Paparazzo lov
programme.desc: U sredu 15. oktobra počinje nova, 17. po redu sezona emisije "Paparazzo lov". Novinari - istraživači prate živote poznatih ličnosti i ove godine i otkrivaju sve njihove skrivene tajne. Tako ćete već u prvoj epizodi videti nekoliko ekskluzivnih priča dugo čuvanih od javnosti. Biće tu i retrospektiva snimaka nastalih tokom leta na crnogorskom, hrvatskom i grčkom primorju. A otrkićemo i nepoznate detalje o aktuelnim učesnicima rijalitija Elita. Voditeljka ove sezone biće Katarina Nikolić. A emisija ide pod sloganom - gledajte samo na Pinku sredom u 23 časa. Nema reprize niti će epizode biti okačene na platformama.

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: "Trenutak iz sna" donosi nam snažne priče o ljudima i njihovim ne uvek tako jednostavnim životima. Njih sudbina nije štedela, što se odrazilo nanjihovo zdravstveno stanje i fizički izgled. Sada im se pruža jedinstvena prilika da putem učešća u emisiji "Trenutak iz sna" promene svoj život.Vrhunski stručnjaci u oblasti hirurgije, stomatologije i kozmetologije pomažu u ostvarivanju njihovih želja, menjajući ne samo njihov izgled već ipsihičko stanje i zdravlje. "Trenutak iz sna" ne menja samo izgled već i život ženama kojima je to najpotrebnije. Tokom dve nedelje, koliko traje proces transformacije, učesnici emisije "Trenutak iz sna" izolovani su od najmilijih, a jedini kontakt između njih je voditeljka Tijana Čurović, koja se trudi da razdvojenost olakša i kandidatima i njihovim porodicama.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Pomoći najvećem broju ugroženih porodica u kratkom roku - to je cilj ekipe serijala Kuća od srca. Razloga zbog koga je ova emisija najhumaniji TV serijal na ovim prostorima je mnogo - na prvom mestu, ekipa na čelu sa Žarkom Lazićem uspela je da zbrine više od 30 višečlanih porodica koje su živele na rubu egzistencije, bez krova nad glavom. Za Žarka ne postoji nemoguće: kroz dosadašnje sezone uspeo je da prevaziđe sve prepreke, čak i onda kada je to izgledalo nemoguće. Kako je TV Pink uvek imala sluha za potrebe najugroženijih, ova humana misija nastavlja se u osmoj sezoni serijala Kuća od srca.

programme.title: DNK
programme.desc: Potraga za neobičnim životnim pričama širom Srbije nastavlja se u emisiji DNK. Natalija Simović pokušaće da uz pomoć rezultata DNK analize unese mir u domove učesnika koji sumnjaju u očinstvo, a rasplet situacija često je turbulentan i dramatičan, a ponekad i komičan. Zbog toga je emisija „DNK već čitavu deceniju u samom vrhu gledanosti.

programme.title: Premijer, serija
programme.desc: PREMIJER je sitkom serija na temu lica i naličja politike i političara. Junaci PREMIJERA iza visokih državnih funkcija kriju ljudske mane i vrline i mi pokušavamo u neskrivenom nušićevskom maniru, da iznesemo pred gledoce smešnu a ponekad i gorku stranu ličnosti onih koji odlučuju o sudbini naroda i zemlje. Naravno, PREMIJER se ne bavi aktuelnim i stvarnim političarima, to bi bila puka estradna imitacija, a i realni političari su se pobrinuli da uđu u naše živote svojom neponovljivošću i originalnošću. Pričati priče o njima bilo bi lažiranje stvarnosti. Naš Premijer igraće se politikom u (ne)dalekoj budućnosti, 2015. godine, kada će mnogo toga biti drugačije u našoj zemlji, osim mentaliteta, sujete, ambicija, podmetanja, borbe za vlast i drugih sitnica koje su, zapravo, krupne teme ove serije. PREMIJER će, pored visoke politike, kao kontrapunkt, sagledavati i privatnost i porodični život političara, domaćih i stranih i dokazati da su, uprkos svemu i oni ipak samo ljudi. Oni iz 2015. godine, razume se.

Naš Premijer igraće se politikom u (ne)dalekoj budućnosti, 2015. godine, kada će mnogo toga biti drugačije u našoj zemlji, osim mentaliteta, sujete, ambicija, podmetanja, borbe za vlast i drugih sitnica koje su, zapravo, krupne teme ove serije. PREMIJER će, pored visoke politike, kao kontrapunkt, sagledavati i privatnost i porodični život političara, domaćih i stranih i dokazati da su, uprkos svemu i oni ipak samo ljudi. Oni iz 2015. godine, razume se.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Paparazzo lov
programme.desc: U sredu 15. oktobra počinje nova, 17. po redu sezona emisije "Paparazzo lov". Novinari - istraživači prate živote poznatih ličnosti i ove godine i otkrivaju sve njihove skrivene tajne. Tako ćete već u prvoj epizodi videti nekoliko ekskluzivnih priča dugo čuvanih od javnosti. Biće tu i retrospektiva snimaka nastalih tokom leta na crnogorskom, hrvatskom i grčkom primorju. A otrkićemo i nepoznate detalje o aktuelnim učesnicima rijalitija Elita. Voditeljka ove sezone biće Katarina Nikolić. A emisija ide pod sloganom - gledajte samo na Pinku sredom u 23 časa. Nema reprize niti će epizode biti okačene na platformama.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Mješoviti brak, serija
programme.desc: Serija "M(j)ešoviti brak" snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Crveni mesec, serija
programme.desc: Ljubavna, ali i snažna istorijska priča, smeštena je u period od avgusta 1913, nakon pobede Srbije u Balkanskim ratovima kada je povratila deo teoritorije, do kraja 1915. godine, kada je austrougarska vojska okupirala Beograd. Glavni junak, mladi srpski oficir koga tumači Miloš Đurović, vraća se sa ratišta u rodnu kuću. Svadba mu je, tradicionalno, već zakazana, ali zaplet priče počinje kada se ćerka austrougarskog poslanika, koju igra Ivana Dudić, zainteresuje za njega. Nedopustivo za to vreme, koketna mlada dama, ne krije svoja osećanja prema mladom oficiru. Rasplet njihove ljubavne drame,koja je plod mašte autora, odvija se u realnom istorijskom periodu pred Veliki rat, pa se u scenariju pojavljuje još dvadesetak glavnih likova, uglavnom stvarnih istorijskih ličnosti. Ovo ostvarenje obiluje dramatičnim događajima, špijunskim intrigama, diplomatskim nadmudrivanjima, političkim spletkama i prevarama...

programme.title: Aller retour, film
programme.desc: Seljak sa porodicom dolazi u Pariz da nađe posao. On se ubrzo zaposli, ali nije zadovoljan, pa često menja poslodavce. U potrazi za boljim poslom nasedne posredniku, koji ga prevari, pa se onako ljut posvađa sa susedom i u svađi ga ubije. Bekstvo, hapšenje, sud i presuda: proterivanje iz Francuske! Po nagovoru žene i sina ipak ostaje i, u provinciji, sa prijateljem, započne samostalni posao, ali ih provalnici opljačkaju što im navuče na vrat policiju. Ugrožen, nervozan, napije se i istuče ženu, a ona ga u očajanju prijavi policiji. Međutim, intervencija policije je nepotrebna, jer on je već mrtav.

programme.title: Petrijin venac, film
programme.desc: Radnja se odvija u malom rudarskom mjestu u Srbiji i obuhvaća predratni, ratni i poslijeratni period. Priča o tragičnom životnom putu nepismene žene sa sela, o njenom životu s trojicom ljudi koje je voljela. Njezin životni put pun trpljenja, samoće, razočaranja, nadanja i ljubavi, prerasta u simbol čovjekove pobjede. Kao literarna potka poslužili su motivi iz istoimenog djela Dragoslava Mihajlovića.

programme.title: Idi mi, dođi mi, film
programme.desc: Mladi bračni par, Marija (Rialda Kadrić) i Boba (Vladimir Petrović) useljavaju u svoj novi stan i kreću u novi život. No uskoro počinju zapostavljati jedno drugo i dijete te život podređuju materijalnim stvarima. Život im ne olakšavaju niti djedovi Žika (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) i Milan (Marko Todorović) koji se uporno miješaju u njihove privatne stvari. Srećom, Marija i Boba će vrlo brzo shvatiti da im je najveća vrijednost obitelj, kao i međusobna bliskost i ljubav. Popularni filmski serijal s područja bivše Jugoslavije, „Lude godine, započeo je svoje prikazivanje davne 1977., a slijedilo je još devet nastavaka do 1992. Sve od reda režirao ih je Zoran Čalić, a sedmi nastavak, snimljen 1985., dobio je naziv „Žikina dinastija. Iako u originalu zamišljena kao ozbiljna drama koja upozorava na društvene probleme poput seksa bez zaštite i tinejdžerske trudnoće, sporedni likovi Živorad "Žika" Pavlović (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) te Milan Todorović (Marko Todorović) istaknuli su svoj talent za komediju te ubrzo preuzeli glavnu riječ. Iako ga filmska struka nije prihvatila, serijal je postao jedan od najpopularnijih u Jugoslaviji, pa čak i u zemljama Istočne Europe. Tako je glumica Rialda Kadrić primila pozivnicu Moskovskog filmskog festivala, koji je tada bio isključivo rezerviran za nove zvijezde Sovjetskog Saveza. Serija se pokazala odličnom odskočnom daskom mnogim budućim zvijezdama bivše Jugoslavije - Sonji Savić, Zoranu Cvijanoviću, Nikoli Koji, Gali Videnović i Branku Đuriću. Naziv serije osmišljen je kao parodija na popularnu američku seriju „Dinastija, koja je sredinom 80-ih osvojila gledatelje s područja tadašnje Jugoslavije.

programme.title: Nije lako sa muškarcima, film
programme.desc: Mladoj, razvedenoj ženi sa tri kćeri i to sve tri u pubertetu, život ni malo nije lak. Sama zarađuje za izdržavanje porodice, trudi se da bude dobra majka, ocu svoje dece prijateljica, da i domaćem ljubimcu, ogromnom psu, pruži toplinu doma. U toj trci ona zaboravlja da je žena i to privlačna. Jedno letovanje uneće mnoge novine u život ove porodice od četiri žene i jednog psa

programme.title: Davitelj protiv davitelja, film
programme.desc: Beograd ima mnoge elemente koji jedan grad čine metropolom, no sve bi to bilo uzdalud da se nije pojavio "kralj zločinaca" - davitelj. Naime, tek kad neki grad ima davitelja, on zaslužuje naziv metropole, poput New Yorka, Pariza ili Londona. Beogradski je davitelj 48-godišnji prodavač karanfila Pera Mitić, na prvi pogled dobričina od 190 centimetara i 120 kila, koji živi s majkom, ljubiteljicom opernih arija koja ga tretira kao dijete. Povrijeđen postupkom djevojaka koje prezirno odbijaju njegove karanfile, u Peri se pali neki podsvjesni okidač i on postaje serijski ubojica, nesvjestan svojih zločina. U neobičnoj telepatskoj vezi s Perom je mladi rocker i sin ugledog psihijatra Spiridon Kopicl, koji mrzi lijepe žene otkad mu je majka umrla, a otac se oženio atraktivnom medicinskom sestrom Natalijom. Spiridon napiše pjesmu Beogradski davitelj koja u izvedbi njegova sastava postaje hit i omiljena Perina pjesma. Istodobno, policijski inspektor Ognjen Strahinjić očajnički pokušava otkriti daviteljev identitet, a njegova sumnja prije svih pada na Spiridona. Spiridon se u međuvremenu zbližio s radijskom i televizijskom voditeljicom Sofijom Mačkić, koja se zamjeri Peri neugodnim primjedbama na račun karanfila... Nakon debakla svog trećeg filma "Kako sam sistematski uništen od idiota", prvog temeljenog na vlastitom scenariju, a ne na predlošcima Dušana Kovačevića, Slobodan Šijan vratio je naklonost publike i kritike sjajnom crnom komedijom "Davitelj protiv davitelja" (1984), koju je scenaristički osmislio u tandemu s filmskim kritičarem i povremenim scenaristom Nebojšem Pajkićem. U njemu se Šijan vratio svojim filmofilskim intertekstualnim i intermedijalnim korijenima, pa dok je osnovni orijentir njegova debija "Tko to tamo pjeva" bila Fordova "Poštanska kočija", a filma "Maratonci trče počasni krug" Magnusov i Bunkerov Alan Ford, ovdje je to "Psiho" Alfreda Hitchcocka. Na Hitchcockovo remek-djelo Šijan se oslanja tematskim i glazbenim motivima, a u ludičku su strukturu filma, među ostalim, ubačeni i međunatpisi kao poveznica s poetikom nijemog filma. U Spiridonovoj grupi VIS Simboli gitaru svira kultni beogradski rocker Srđan Kojić Koja, nekadašnji član Šarla akrobate i vođa Discipline kičme. Ime grupe očito se referira na znamenitu beogradsku skupinu VIS Idoli, sastav čiji je lider, uz Vladu Divljana, bio nositelj uloge Spiridona, Srđan Šaper. "Davitelj protiv davitelja" također je i film koji je navijestio i danas aktualan srbijanski filmski podžanr (urbane) rock'n'roll komedije.

programme.title: Kada budem mrtav i beo, film
programme.desc: Priča o mladom sezonskom radniku labilnih moralnih kvaliteta, koji, ostavši bez posla, posle dugog lutanja i mnogih pokušaja da nađe svoje mesto u društvu i životu, bez utočišta i podrške, tragično završava život.

programme.title: Kakav deda takav unuk, film
programme.desc: Boba i Marija su zaposleni, imaju stan i sina i naizgled je sve uredu. Ali, dok su oni zauzeti svakodnevnim brigama, njihovog sina čuvaju djedovi i tu nastaju problemi. Njegov otac želi da unuka oblikuje po svojoj mjeri, a njen otac želi da mu obezbjedi klasično obrazovanje: muziku, jezike, itd. Zbog toga dolazi do niza sukoba i komičnih situacija. Četvrti nastavak urnebesnog serijala započetog filmom "Lude godine".

programme.title: Guča, film
programme.desc: Radnja filma je smještena na obroncima planine Jelice, a glavni junaci su tinejdžeri Julijana i Romeo. Ona je kćerka najpoznatijeg lokalnog "bijelog" trubača Sačma Trandafilovića, šefa trubačkog orkestra, a on Rom, virtuoz na trubi, čiji je očuh šef suparničkog muzičkog tabora "Sandokanovi tigrovi". Nažalost, Romeo je u nemilosti kod Julijaninog oca zbog različite rasne pripadnosti. Zbog toga, mladić pokušava na poznatom Saboru dokazati kako je najbolji trubač, jer samo tako može dobiti dozvolu njenog oca i koji će njihovu vezu učiniti dostupnijom.

programme.title: Zajedno, film
programme.desc: Uroš je cijenjeni, nagrađivani beogradski književnik, nekadašnji profesor, koji sa ženom Marijom i sinom Nikolom živi u kući na Neimaru. Već neko vrijeme je u kreativnoj krizi uzrokovanoj, između ostalog, i aferom koju je imao sa svojom studentkinjom prije nekoliko godina. Marija to nikada nije sasvim preboljela. Ona je nezadovoljna njihovim brakom i zaglavljena u izvanbračnoj vezi s Markom, uspješnim biznismenom. Jedne noći kada Uroš, Marijinom nesmotrenošću, otkrije dokaz preljube, brak konačno puca. Ona odlučuje otići s Markom i povesti Nikolu sa sobom. Ali Uroš ima druge planove.

programme.title: Stanica običnih vozova, film
programme.desc: Slika odnosa u bosanskom selu nakon II svjetskog rata, kada u selo umjesto učitelja pošalju učiteljicu. Pedesetih godina, mlada učiteljica iz Beograda, nakon završene škole, a po nalogu Ministarstva prosvjete dolazi u zabito mjesto kako bi učila narod. Nespremna, neiskusna i nejaka, nije uspjela da sagradi most između sebe i nove sredine. Sistem ustaljenih vrijednosti i odnosa biva doveden u pitanje. Uloge: Ljiljana Međeši, Emir Hadžihafizbegović, Dančo Čevrevski, Enver Petrovci Reditelj: Nenad Dizdarević

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers & The Young Retro's, Modern
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the Tilburg based Bertus Borgers and his Young Retro's!

programme.title: H. Jones, J. Woode, C. Lucas - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, an alto sax choir consisting of Bob Wilber, Marshall Royal, Piet Noordijk, Lee Konitz, Sonny Fortune, Julius Hemphill, Carlos Ward, Richie Cole, and Paquito D'Rivera performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. They were accompanied by a rhythm section of the decorated pianist and bandleader Hank Jones, bassist Jimmy Woode and drummer Clyde Lucas.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Funk & Afro, Funk
programme.desc: The term "jam-session" was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call "jammin' the beat". Today, the Seine Sessions revive the happy years of "jam sessions", while the cream of jazz, blues, gipsy and funk Parisian scenes occurs on the boards of the legendary restaurant and jazz club Le Réservoir. Entitled "Funk & Afro", this episode hosted by Eddy King features unique performances by artists playing together for the first time, and interviews with Cool Jam, Bibi Tanga, Kingsy Ray, and many others.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom, Fusion
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009. This ensemble of musicians from Germany and various guest countries performs as part of the festival's opening concert. This episode includes performances sometimes energetic, sometimes soft and soothing.

programme.title: It's Up To You, Concert
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, the acclaimed jazz fusion group Mahavishnu Orchestra led by guitarist John McLaughlin took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. This third incarnation of the group featured an outstanding lineup, with Jim Beard on keyboards, Jonas Hellborg on bass, Danny Gottlieb on drums, and Bill Evans on saxophone.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano & Dauner live in Stuttgart, Latin
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads. This rare, vibrant and intense performance is an intimate collaboration with Charlie Mariano (saxophone) and Wolfgang Dauner (piano) and features music ranging from tango and classical music to international favorites.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet", Jazz
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg’s Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation’s message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba, Jazz
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto). Powell is joined by Ernesto Ribeiro-Gonçalves on double bass, Helio Schiavo on drums, and Alfredo Bessa on percussion.

programme.title: Arturo Sandoval - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, Cuban trumpeter Arturo Sandoval brought his band with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Featuring talented performers like pianist Hilario Durán and guitarist Jorge Chicoy, they displayed a master class in Latin jazz fusion.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience, Jazz
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY, Jazz
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work "Soley" inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle. Aided by Chris Jennings on double bass and Tilo Bertholo on drums, Privat makes his debut as a singer, adding a vocal dimension to the instrumental and narrative levels of "Soley", which lends his music an emotional force that is more powerful than ever before.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles, Jazz
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly, Concert
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays C-Jam Blues in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's Humoresque in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition Round About Midnight in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of Sweet and Lovely at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of Sly in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's Song for my Father performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Hackensack, Concert
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs Autumn Leaves, Hackensack, My Favorite Things, I Want To Talk About You, Vigil, and Naima. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève, Fusion
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies. The resulting soundscape is innocent, yet fascinating. Sail away on the aural wings of music from their debut album New Year (2013).

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich, Modern
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980. Domino was one of the pioneers of rock and roll music, selling more than 65 million records and having 11 top hits between 1955 and 1960.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018, World
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Edina Szirtes Mokus, expresses her talents in a restless exploration across multiple genres, manifested in her prolific output which includes her work with various artists as well as her own band, string quartet, singer/songwriter projects and compositions for musicals and dance theatre.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus, Modern
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. This episode presents ‘Linus’, a duo of two composers and improvisers: baritone guitar player Ruben Machtelinckx and tenor saxophonist Thomas Jillings. The intense sound produced by the tenor saxophone and the acoustic baritone guitar yields melodies that take you on a journey through a world of simplicity, purity, and longing.

programme.title: Lorena's Tango, Concert
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire - the deep classical music of West Africa - permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1988, acclaimed Brazilian singer and pianist Tania Maria performed with bassist Leonard Traversa and drummer Kim Plainfield at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Maria is known for her energetic personality and unique style of singing that draws from a variety of jazz, Latin and pop traditions.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans, Smooth
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album Swiss Movement which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today’s broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann’s vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including Just Like Magic, backed by his wonderful Magic Band of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop, Concert
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Since You're Gone, Concert
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Joining him to play songs from their joint album "Collaborations" was Grammy award-winning acoustic guitarist Earl Klugh.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988, Modern
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile seems to change the feel of the music. In 1988, Swallow and Bley began performing duet concerts in Europe, United States, South America and Japan. This performance of Duets, their album of songs arranged for piano and bass, was released that same year. The performance showcases their approach to traditional jazz, folk and classical music, as well as their poignant musical story.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan, Jazz
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Sjevernjačka utjeha, film
programme.desc: Veterana specijalnih postrojbi, uštogljenu poduzetnicu, influensericu s pola milijuna pratitelja i nesposobnog instruktora spojio je vrhunski tečaj razbijanja straha od letenja. Posljednji izazov tečaja je iskustveni let od Londona do Islanda, koji na kraju postane užasno mučenje. Izgubljeni na Islandu, smrznuti i prestravljeni, moraju pronaći način da se suoče sa svojim strahovima i surađuju kako bi raširili svoja krila... i poletjeli.

programme.title: Raj za dame, serija
programme.desc: Talijanska televizijska serija nastala prema romanu Emilea Zole 'Au Bonheur des dames' iz 1883., no radnja je premještena u Milano, 1956. godine. Glavni lik je Teresa, mlada žena koja ostavi Salva, zaručnika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Teresa se nada da će se ondje zaposliti u stričevoj trgovini. No kad stigne u Milano, dozna da joj je stric na rubu bankrota i da je optužen za palež kombija ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pietro Mori, mladi poduzetnik upitne prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD u poslijeratno doba uspio otvoriti elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću. Teresa se prijavi na natječaj za prodavačicu u robnoj kući. Nakon niza peripetija uspije se zaposliti i pokaže da je ambiciozna i poduzetna djevojka i ubrzo stekne povjerenje kolega. Djevojka se na kraju ludo zaljubi u Pietra Morija, no mora se vratiti na Siciliju jer je njezin otac obećao gradonačelniku Castelbuona da će se Teresa udati za njegovog sina Salva.

programme.title: Kulturni centar
programme.desc: Za istraživanje lika i dela Jovana Sterije Popovića nije neophodan poseban povod, ali on i ovaj put postoji, jer se ove godine obeležava 220 godina od njegovog rođenja u Vršcu, gde Narodno pozorište ponosno nosi njegovo ime. Sterija je u devetnaestom veku bio jedan od ključnih autora koji su uobličili domaću dramsku književnost. Na tragu Molijerovih komedija, ili Šilerovih misli o pozorištu kao prostoru moralnog uzdizanja, Sterijina dramska dela su nastajala sa uverenjem da mogu popraviti ljudske mane.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 120. epizoda - Selma za Bajram poklanja Erenu narukvicu koju je sama napravila. Merve primorava Džemila da prizna da je on platio prvu ratu njene školarine. Halil potom kaže Džemilu da će on preuzeti plaćanje ostalih rata. Halil je sretan što Aslanliji ostaju na imanju i dijeli pomoć siromašnima sa Zejnep. Hakan se pravda Guldže da je u njenoj sobi tražio punjač za telefon. Songul je očajna što Aslanliji ostaju na imanju i naređuje svom čovjeku da ubije Zejnep.

programme.title: Zarobljena, serija

programme.title: VIJESTI
programme.desc: informativna emisija s prijevodom na znakovni jezik Vijesti Libertas televizije središnja su informativna emisija koja svakodnevno (od ponedjeljka do petka) donosi cjelovite, pravodobne i provjerene informacije. Kroz Vijesti progovaramo o problemima Dubrovnika i Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije. Građanima omogućujemo ostvarivanje prava na javno informiranje njegujući kulturnu raznolikost i dubrovačku baštinu uz poštivanje nacionalne, rasne, spolne i vjerske ravnopravnosti. Uz aktualne, a lokalne teme u Vijestima pratimo društveno-politički, kulturni i sportski život dubrovačke regije. U svakodnevnom smo kontaktu s gledateljima jer mišljenje građana nam je najvažnije.

programme.desc: Jutarnji program Libertas televizije mozaična je emisija koju čini niz informativnih i zabavnih sadržaja, uz biranu glazbu i kadrove s panoramskih kamera postavljenih na gradskom zvoniku i tvrđavi Imperijal. Dežurni voditelj iz novinarske redakcije LTV-a, u formatu radijskog voditelja gledatelje informira o vijestima iz društvenog života, kulture i sporta te objavljuje korisne informacije komunalnih tvrtki, stanje u cestovnom, pomorskom i zračnom prometu. Kroz Jutarnji program najavljujemo sva važna događanja u Dubrovačkoj regiji, programe kulturnih institucija i festivala. U program se svakodnevno javljaju i novinarske ekipe s terena, a emisija je otvorena i za pozive gledatelja koje povremeno darivamo ulaznicama i sl. poklonima. Redovite tjedne rubrike rezervirane su za naše dopisnike iz Konavala i Župe, s Pelješca, Korčule, povremeno i drugih otoka. Redovite rubrike imaju dopisici iz doline Neretve, a povremene dubrovački iseljenici iz raznih krajeva svijeta.

programme.title: Miraculous: Pustolovine Bubamare i Crnog Mačka
programme.desc: Samo oni mogu spasiti Pariz od zlikovaca! Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

programme.title: Miraculous: Pustolovine Bubamare i Crnog Mačka
programme.desc: Samo oni mogu spasiti Pariz od zlikovaca! Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Danju su sedmogodišnji Connor, Amaya i Greg obični školarci kao i sva druga djeca njihove dobi. No, kad se u gradu dogodi kakva nevolja, ovi posebno znatiželjni i pravdoljubivi mališani spremni su za svoju misiju. Kako bi ostali neopaženi, moraju čekati noć i da grad utone u san. U to vrijeme, umjesto da se kao i njihovi vršnjaci pripremaju za spavanje, naši junaci navlače svoje pidžame i čarobno se transformiraju u superjunake, PJ Masks. Oni postaju Catboy, superbrz i okretan dječak, Gekko, nevjerojatno snažan dječak koji može pomicati zidove te Owlette, djevojčica koja može letjeti i vidjeti na velike udaljenosti. Zajedno, ovo troje superdjece mogu svladati bilo koji problem - PJ Masks plove u noć kako bi spasili dan! Animirana serija "PJ Masks" nastala je prema maštovitom, originalnom i zapanjujućem serijalu bestseler knjiga Les Pyjamasques, francuskog autora Romualda Racioppoa. U njegovoj rodnoj Francuskoj, u kojoj je prva knjiga iz serijala objavljena 2008., do danas je objavljeno impresivnih 15 naslova, s planom izdavanja čak dva nova naslova svake godine pa s pravom možemo govoriti o izdavačkom pothvatu. "PJ Masks" prikazuje uzbudljive noćne pothvate troje mladih prijatelja koji se s mrakom, odnosno navlačenjem svojih pidžama i aktivacijom svojih životinjskih amajlija, transformiraju u svoja superjunačka alter ega, Catboya, Owlette i Gekka. Tako opremljeni, zajedno se upuštaju u akcijske pustolovine, rješavaju zagonetke i pritom usvajaju vrijedne životne pouke.

programme.title: Elvis, film
programme.desc: Elvis je epski spektakl na velikom platnu Warner Bros. Picturesa i vizionarskog, za Oscara nominiranog filmaša Baza Luhrmanna koji istražuje život i glazbu Elvisa Presleya, s Austinom Butlerom i oskarovcem Tomom Hanksom u glavnim ulogama. Izrazito filmična drama, Elvisova (Butler) priča sagledana je kroz prizmu njegova kompliciranog odnosa sa zagonetnim menadžerom, pukovnikom Tomom Parkerom (Hanks). S Parkerom kao pripovjedačem, film zadire u složenu dinamiku između njih dvojice koja se protezala kroz 20 godina, od Presleyjeva uspona do slave do njegovog statusa zvijezde bez presedana, u kontekstu evoluirajućeg kulturnog krajolika i gubitka nevinosti u Americi. U središtu tog putovanja jedna je od značajnih i utjecajnih osoba u Elvisovom životu, Priscilla Presley (Olivia DeJonge).
